## Session init checklist

For unfamiliar repos or support-file setup only:

1. Resolve the repo root; confirm with `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` when available.
2. Read `CONTINUITY.md` if present.
3. Read `.github/instructions/FILES.md` only before support-doc changes.
4. Read `.github/instructions/LEDGER_RULES.md` only before ledger creation or material updates.
5. Create files from `.github/instructions/templates/` only when needed.
